title.zh: 卷四十四 志第二十五: 兵 兵制 禁軍之制 養兵之法
title.en: Volume 44 Treatises 25: Military - Military Administration, Administration of Imperial Guards, Methods for Training Troops
title.raw: 卷四十四 志第二十五: 兵 兵制 禁軍之制 養兵之法 Volume 44 Treatises 25: Military - Military Administration, Administration of Imperial Guards, Methods for Training Troops

sentences.zh: 金興，用兵如神，戰勝功取，無敵當世，曾未十年遂定大業。

translations.literal: When the Jin rose, they employed troops as if by divinity; in battle they won and took achievement, without rival in their age; within scarcely ten years they then settled the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin dynasty arose, it wielded its armies with uncanny mastery; in every campaign it won victories and seized merit, unmatched in its age, and within less than ten years had secured its great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 原其成功之速，俗本鷙勁，人多沉雄，兄弟子姓才皆良將，部落保伍技皆銳兵。

translations.literal: Tracing the reason for their swift success: their customs were fundamentally fierce and hardy; their people were mostly deep and bold; brothers and sons and clansmen in talent were all fine generals; tribal companies and squads in skill were all sharp troops.
translations.idiomatic: The reason for their swift success lay in customs that were fierce and hardy by nature, a people mostly grave and bold, brothers and kinsmen who were all capable generals, and tribal companies whose skills made every squad a sharp fighting force.

sentences.zh: 加之地狹產薄，無事苦耕可給衣食，有事苦戰可致俘獲，勞其筋骨以能寒暑，徵發調遣事同一家。

translations.literal: Moreover the land was narrow and produce thin; when without affairs they toiled at farming to supply food and clothing; when with affairs they toiled at fighting to obtain captives; they worked sinews and bones to be able to endure cold and heat; levy, dispatch, and assignment were matters like one household.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the land was cramped and yields meager: in peace they labored at farming to supply food and clothing, in war they labored at fighting to win captives; they hardened sinew and bone to endure heat and cold, and conscription and dispatch were handled as though by a single household.

sentences.zh: 是故將勇而志一，兵精而力齊，一旦奮起，變弱為強，以寡制眾，用是道也。

translations.literal: Therefore generals were brave and wills one, troops refined and strength aligned; once they roused themselves, they changed weakness into strength and used the few to control the many—by this method.
translations.idiomatic: Thus their commanders were brave and of one mind, their soldiers elite and their strength coordinated; when they roused themselves at once, they turned weakness into strength and used the few to overcome the many—this was the method they employed.

sentences.zh: 及其得志中國，自顧其宗族國人尚少，乃割土地、崇位號以假漢人，使為之效力而守之。

translations.literal: When they had attained their aim in China, seeing that their clansmen and countrymen were still few, they then carved out lands and exalted titles and ranks to lend to Han people, making them exert strength on their behalf and guard these holdings.
translations.idiomatic: Once they had gained their foothold in China, aware that their own clansmen and Jurchen countrymen were still few, they carved out lands and elevated titles to invest in Han subjects, whom they set to serve and hold these territories for them.

sentences.zh: 猛安謀克雜廁漢地，聽與契丹、漢人昏因以相固結。

translations.literal: Meng'an and mouke were mixed into Han territories; they were permitted to marry with Khitan and Han people by marriage ties so as to bind one another firmly.
translations.idiomatic: Meng'an and mouke units were interspersed among Han territories, and their members were allowed to marry Khitan and Han people so as to forge lasting bonds.

sentences.zh: 迨夫國勢浸盛，則歸土地、削位號，罷遼東渤海、漢人之襲猛安謀克者，漸以兵柄歸其內族。

translations.literal: When the state's power gradually grew great, they then returned lands and reduced titles and ranks, abolished the hereditary succession of meng'an and mouke among Eastern Liao, Bohai, and Han people, and gradually returned the military authority to their inner clans.
translations.idiomatic: As state power grew ever greater, they reclaimed lands and stripped titles, abolished hereditary meng'an and mouke status among the Eastern Liao, Bohai, and Han populations, and gradually concentrated military authority in their own inner clans.

sentences.zh: 然樞府簽軍募軍兼采漢制，伐宋之役參用漢軍及諸部族而統以國人，非不知制勝長策在於以志一之將、用力齊之兵也，第以土宇既廣，豈得盡任其所親哉！

translations.literal: Yet the Privy Council drafted and recruited troops while also adopting Han institutions; in the campaign against Song they employed Han armies and various tribal groups together, yet placed Jurchen countrymen in overall command—not because they did not know that the long strategy for victory lay in generals of one will and troops of aligned strength, but because their territory was already vast—how could they entrust everything only to their kin!
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Privy Council drafted and recruited troops while also adopting Han military institutions; in the war against Song they mixed Han armies and various tribal forces under Jurchen command—not because they had forgotten that victory depended on commanders of one mind and soldiers acting in concert, but because their realm had grown too vast to place every command solely in the hands of kinsmen.

sentences.zh: 馴致極盛，乃自患其宗族國人之多，積其猜疑，卒自戕賊，遂致強本刊落，醇風鍥薄，將帥攜離，兵士驕惰。

translations.literal: Gradually reaching utmost prosperity, they then themselves worried over the multitude of their clansmen and countrymen, accumulated suspicions, and in the end destroyed one another, so that the strong branches were cut away, pure customs were carved thin, generals and commanders split apart, and soldiers grew arrogant and slack.
translations.idiomatic: As they gradually reached the height of power, they began to fear the growing numbers of their own clansmen and Jurchen countrymen; suspicions piled up until they slaughtered one another, the strong branches were pruned away, honest customs thinned out, commanders fell out with one another, and soldiers grew arrogant and indolent.

sentences.zh: 迄其亡也，「忠孝」等軍構難於內，颭軍雜人召禍于外，向之所謂志一而力齊者，不見可恃之勢焉。

translations.literal: By the time of their fall, armies such as "Loyalty and Filial Piety" stirred trouble within, while zhan armies and miscellaneous people summoned calamity from without; what had formerly been called one will and aligned strength—no dependable force of that kind could be seen.
translations.idiomatic: By the time of their fall, armies such as the Loyalty and Filial Piety forces were fomenting trouble within, while zhan troops and miscellaneous levies were inviting disaster from without; the unity of purpose and coordinated strength they had once possessed was nowhere to be found.

sentences.zh: 豈非自壞其家法而致是歟？

translations.literal: Was this not because they themselves ruined their own house laws and brought this about?
translations.idiomatic: Was this not the result of their having destroyed their own institutional foundations?

sentences.zh: 抑是道也可用於新造之邦，不可以保長久之天下歟？

translations.literal: Or perhaps this method could be used for a newly founded state, but could not preserve a long-lasting realm under Heaven?
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps this method could serve a newly founded state, but could not secure an empire meant to endure?

sentences.zh: 金以兵得國，奉詔作《金史》，故于金之《兵志》考其興亡得失之跡，特著於斯。

translations.literal: The Jin gained the realm through arms; by imperial order the History of Jin was composed, and therefore in the Jin Military Treatise the traces of rise and fall, gain and loss, are examined and set forth here in particular.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin won their realm by force of arms; by imperial command the History of Jin was compiled, and so in this Military Treatise the record of their rise and fall, success and failure, is examined and set forth in detail.

sentences.zh: 兵制、馬政、養兵等法載諸舊史者，暼戶列於篇。

translations.literal: Regulations on military organization, horse administration, troop maintenance, and the like recorded in the old histories are briefly listed by household in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Laws governing military organization, horse administration, troop maintenance, and related matters recorded in earlier histories are summarized by category in this chapter.

sentences.zh: 金之初年，諸部之民無它徭役，壯者皆兵，平居則聽以佃漁射獵習為勞事，有警則下令部內，及遣使詣諸孛堇徵兵，凡步騎之仗糗皆取備焉。

translations.literal: In the Jin's early years, the people of the various tribes had no other corvée; the able-bodied were all soldiers. In ordinary times they were permitted to farm, fish, hunt, and shoot to practice laborious tasks; when there was an alarm an order went out within the tribe, and envoys were sent to the various beli to levy troops; all infantry and cavalry weapons and provisions were made ready.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jin's early years, the people of the various tribes bore no other corvée labor; every able-bodied man was a soldier. In peacetime they were allowed to farm, fish, hunt, and practice the strenuous skills of their trade; when alarm arose, orders went out within the tribe and envoys were dispatched to the various beli chiefs to levy troops, and every weapon and ration for foot and horse was made ready.

sentences.zh: 其部長曰孛堇，行兵則稱曰猛安、謀克，從其多寡以為號，猛安者千夫長也，謀克者百夫長也。

translations.literal: Their tribal chiefs were called beli; when marching troops they were styled meng'an and mouke according to their numbers as titles—meng'an were chiefs of a thousand, mouke were chiefs of a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Their tribal leaders were called beli; on campaign they were styled meng'an or mouke according to the size of their command—a meng'an was a commander of a thousand, a mouke a commander of a hundred.

sentences.zh: 謀克之副曰蒲裏衍，士卒之副從曰阿裏喜。

translations.literal: The mouke's deputy was called puliyan; the soldiers' deputies and followers were called alixi.
translations.idiomatic: A mouke's deputy was called a puliyan; soldiers' deputies and attendants were called alixi.

sentences.zh: 部卒之數，初無定制。

translations.literal: The number of troops in a unit at first had no fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: At first there was no fixed regulation governing the number of men in a unit.

sentences.zh: 至太祖即位之二年，既以二千五百破耶律謝十，始命以三百戶為謀克，謀克十為猛安。

translations.literal: By the second year of Taizu's accession, having with twenty-five hundred broken Yelü Xie Shi, he first ordered that three hundred households form a mouke and ten mouke form a meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Emperor Taizu's reign, after defeating Yelü Xie Shi with twenty-five hundred men, he first decreed that three hundred households should constitute a mouke and ten mouke a meng'an.

sentences.zh: 繼而諸部來降，率用猛安、謀克之名以授其首領而部伍其人。

translations.literal: Thereafter when the various tribes came to surrender, they generally used the names meng'an and mouke to invest their chiefs and organize their people into companies.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, as the various tribes submitted, the titles meng'an and mouke were routinely bestowed on their leaders to organize their people into military companies.

sentences.zh: 出河之戰兵始滿萬，而遼莫敵矣！

translations.literal: At the Battle beyond the River the troops first reached ten thousand, and the Liao had no one who could match them!
translations.idiomatic: At the Battle beyond the River their forces first reached ten thousand men, and the Liao had no one who could stand against them.

sentences.zh: 及來流、鴨水、鐵驪、鱉古之民皆附，東京既平，山西繼定，內收遼、漢之降卒，外籍部族之健士。

translations.literal: When the peoples of Lailiu, Yashui, Tieli, and Biegu all attached themselves, Eastern Capital was pacified and Shanxi was secured in succession; within they took in surrendered troops of Liao and Han, from without they enrolled stalwart warriors of tribal groups.
translations.idiomatic: When the peoples of Lailiu, the Yalu, Tieli, and Biegu all submitted, the Eastern Capital was pacified and Shanxi secured in turn; within they absorbed surrendered Liao and Han troops, and from without they enrolled stalwart warriors from allied tribes.

sentences.zh: 嘗用遼人訛裏野以北部百三十戶為一謀克，漢人王六兒以諸州漢人六十五戶為一謀克，王伯龍及高從祐等並領所部為一猛安。

translations.literal: They once used the Liao man Woliye to make one hundred thirty northern households a mouke, the Han man Wang Liu'er to make sixty-five Han households from the various prefectures a mouke, and Wang Bolong and Gao Congyou and others each to lead their companies as one meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: At one point the Liao subject Woliye was assigned one mouke of one hundred thirty northern households; the Han subject Wang Liu'er one mouke of sixty-five Han households drawn from various prefectures; and Wang Bolong, Gao Congyou, and others each commanded their followers as a separate meng'an.

sentences.zh: 至天會二年，平州既平，宗望恐風俗揉雜，民情弗便，乃罷是制。

translations.literal: By the second year of Tianhui, when Pingzhou had been pacified, Zongwang feared that customs would be blended and mixed and the people's feelings would not find it convenient, and therefore abolished this system.
translations.idiomatic: By the second year of the Tianhui reign, after Pingzhou had been pacified, Zongwang feared that mingling customs would unsettle the populace and abolished this arrangement.

sentences.zh: 諸部降人但置長吏，以下從漢官之號。

translations.literal: For surrendered peoples of the various tribes they only installed chief officials, and below them followed Han official titles.
translations.idiomatic: For surrendered tribes they installed only chief officials, with subordinates bearing Han-style titles.

sentences.zh: 四年，伐宋之役，調燕山、雲中、中京、上京、東京、遼東、平州、遼西、長春八路民兵，隸諸萬戶，其間萬戶亦有專統漢軍者。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, in the campaign against Song, militia of the eight routes—Yanshan, Yunzhong, Central Capital, Upper Capital, Eastern Capital, Eastern Liao, Pingzhou, Western Liao, and Changchun—were levied and placed under the various wanhu; among them some wanhu also exclusively commanded Han armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, for the campaign against Song, militia from the eight circuits of Yanshan, Yunzhong, the Central Capital, the Upper Capital, the Eastern Capital, Eastern Liao, Pingzhou, Western Liao, and Changchun were mobilized and assigned to various wanhu commanders, some of whom commanded Han forces exclusively.

sentences.zh: 熙宗皇統五年，又罷遼東漢人、渤海猛安謀克承襲之制，浸移兵柄於其國人，乃分猛安謀克為上中下三等，宗室為上，餘次之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Huangtong under Emperor Xizong, they again abolished the hereditary succession of meng'an and mouke among Eastern Liao Han and Bohai people, gradually shifting military authority to their countrymen; they then divided meng'an and mouke into upper, middle, and lower grades, with the imperial clan as upper and the rest below.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Huangtong era under Emperor Xizong, hereditary meng'an and mouke status among Eastern Liao Han and Bohai populations was abolished and military authority gradually shifted to Jurchen countrymen; meng'an and mouke were then divided into upper, middle, and lower grades, with the imperial clan in the highest tier and all others below.

sentences.zh: 至海陵庶人天德二年，省並中京、東京、臨潢、咸平、泰州等路節鎮及猛安謀克，削上中下之名，但稱為「諸猛安謀克，」循舊制間年一徵發，以補老疾死亡之數。

translations.literal: By the second year of Tiande under the Deposed Emperor Hailing, they merged and reduced the military commissioners and meng'an-mouke of the routes of Central Capital, Eastern Capital, Linhuang, Xianping, Taizhou, and others; they cut the names upper, middle, and lower and only called them "the various meng'an and mouke," following the old system of levying once every other year to replace those old, ill, or dead.
translations.idiomatic: By the second year of the Tiande era under the Deposed Emperor Hailing, military commissioners and meng'an-mouke units along the Central Capital, Eastern Capital, Linhuang, Xianping, Taizhou, and other routes were consolidated; the upper, middle, and lower grades were abolished and all were styled simply "the various meng'an and mouke," with levies every other year under the old system to replace men lost to age, illness, or death.

sentences.zh: 貞元遷都，遂徙上京路太祖、遼王宗幹、秦王宗翰之猛安，並為合紮猛安，及右諫議烏裏補猛安，太師勖、宗正宗敏之族，處之中都。

translations.literal: When the capital was moved in the Zhenyuan era, they then moved the meng'an of Taizu, Prince of Liao Zonggan, and Prince of Qin Zonghan from the Upper Capital route, all made hezha meng'an, together with the meng'an of Right Remonstrator Wulibu, Grand Preceptor Xu, and the clans of Zongzheng Zongmin, placing them in the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital was relocated in the Zhenyuan era, the meng'an of Taizu, Prince of Liao Zonggan, and Prince of Qin Zonghan from the Upper Capital circuit were transferred and reorganized as hezha meng'an, along with the meng'an of Right Remonstrator Wulibu and the clans of Grand Preceptor Xu and Zongzheng Zongmin, all resettled at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 斡論、和尚、胡剌三國公，太保昂，詹事烏裏野，輔國勃魯骨，定遠許烈，故杲國公勃迭八猛安處之山東。

translations.literal: The three dukes of the state Wolun, Heshang, and Hula, Grand Guardian Ang, Household Master Wuliye, Assistant to the State Bolugu, Dingyuan Xu Lie, and the meng'an of the late Duke of Guo Bodieba were placed in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: The meng'an of the three state dukes Wolun, Heshang, and Hula, Grand Guardian Ang, Household Master Wuliye, Assistant to the State Bolugu, Dingyuan Xu Lie, and the late Duke of Guo Bodieba were resettled in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 阿魯之族處之北京。

translations.literal: The clan of Alu was placed in the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The clan of Alu was resettled in the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 按達族屬處之河間。

translations.literal: The kinsmen of Anda were placed in Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: The kinsmen of Anda were resettled in Hejian.

sentences.zh: 正隆二年，命兵部尚書蕭恭等，與舊軍皆分隸諸總管府、節度使，授田牛使之耕食，以蕃衛京國。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenglong, they ordered Minister of War Xiao Gong and others, together with the old armies, all to be divided and subordinated to the various chief commanders' offices and military commissioners; they granted fields and cattle so they could farm for food, to multiply and guard the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Zhenglong era, Minister of War Xiao Gong and others were ordered to assign the old armies to various chief commanders' offices and military commissioners, grant them fields and cattle for subsistence farming, and thereby strengthen the defense of the capital region.

sentences.zh: 六年，南伐，立三道都統制府及左右領軍大都督，將三十二軍，以神策、神威、神捷、神銳、神毅、神翼、神勇、神果、神略、神鋒、武勝、武定、武威、武安、武捷、武平、武成、武毅、武銳、武揚、武翼、武震、威定、威信、威勝、威捷、威烈、威毅、威震、威略、威果、威勇為名，軍置都總管、副總管及巡察使、副各一員。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on the southern campaign, they established three-route supreme command offices and left and right supreme commanders leading the armies, commanding thirty-two armies named Divine Strategy, Divine Might, Divine Swiftness, Divine Sharpness, Divine Resolve, Divine Wings, Divine Courage, Divine Fruit, Divine Design, Divine Edge, Martial Victory, Martial Stability, Martial Prestige, Martial Peace, Martial Swiftness, Martial Balance, Martial Success, Martial Resolve, Martial Sharpness, Martial Raise, Martial Wings, Martial Thunder, Awesome Stability, Awesome Trust, Awesome Victory, Awesome Swiftness, Awesome Fierceness, Awesome Resolve, Awesome Thunder, Awesome Design, Awesome Fruit, and Awesome Courage; each army had one chief commander, one deputy commander, and one inspector and deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, for the southern campaign, three supreme command offices and left and right supreme army commanders were established to lead thirty-two armies bearing names such as Divine Strategy, Divine Might, Divine Swiftness, Divine Sharpness, Divine Resolve, Divine Wings, Divine Courage, Divine Fruit, Divine Design, Divine Edge, Martial Victory, Martial Stability, Martial Prestige, Martial Peace, Martial Swiftness, Martial Balance, Martial Success, Martial Resolve, Martial Sharpness, Martial Raise, Martial Wings, Martial Thunder, Awesome Stability, Awesome Trust, Awesome Victory, Awesome Swiftness, Awesome Fierceness, Awesome Resolve, Awesome Thunder, Awesome Design, Awesome Fruit, and Awesome Courage; each army was assigned a chief commander, a deputy commander, and an inspector with his deputy.

sentences.zh: 而沿邊契丹恐妻孥被鄰寇鈔掠，不可盡行，遂皆背判。

translations.literal: But the Khitan along the borders feared that wives and children would be plundered by neighboring enemies and could not all march out, and therefore all turned in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: But Khitan troops along the frontier, fearing that their wives and children would be plundered by neighboring enemies if they marched away, could not all be mobilized and consequently rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 而大名續授甲之士還迎立世宗于東京。

translations.literal: Meanwhile at Daming, soldiers who had just been issued armor in succession returned to welcome and establish Emperor Shizong at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile at Daming, soldiers who had only just been issued armor turned back to install Emperor Shizong at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 及大定之初，窩斡既平，乃散契丹隸諸猛安謀克。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Dading era, once Wowo had been pacified, they then dispersed the Khitan and attached them to the various meng'an and mouke.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Dading era, after the Wowo rebellion had been suppressed, the Khitan were dispersed and assigned to various meng'an and mouke units.

sentences.zh: 至三年，詔河北、山東等路所簽軍，有父兄俱已充甲軍，子弟又為阿裏喜，恐其家更無丁男，有誤農種，與免一丁，以驅丁充阿裏喜，無驅丁者于本猛安謀克內驗富強有驅丁者簽充。

translations.literal: By the third year, an edict addressed drafted troops of Hebei, Shandong, and other routes: where fathers and elder brothers were both already serving as armored soldiers and younger sons also served as alixi, fearing that the household would have no adult males left and farming would suffer, one man was exempted; a bond servant was used as alixi instead, and where there was no bond servant, within the local meng'an and mouke they verified the wealthy and strong who had bond servants and drafted them to fill the post.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year an edict addressed drafted troops in Hebei, Shandong, and other circuits: where fathers and elder brothers already served as armored soldiers and younger sons also served as alixi attendants, lest households be left without adult males and farming suffer, one man was exempted and a bond servant substituted as alixi; where no bond servant was available, wealthy households with bond servants within the local meng'an and mouke were identified and drafted to fill the post.

sentences.zh: 十三年，徙東北等戌邊漢軍於內地。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, they moved Han armies garrisoning the northeast and other border regions into the interior.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Han border garrisons in the northeast and elsewhere were transferred to the interior.

sentences.zh: 十五年十月，遣吏部郎中蒲察兀虎等十人分行天下，再定猛安謀克戶，每謀克戶不過三百，七謀克至十謀克置一猛安。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifteenth year, they dispatched Ministry of Personnel Director Pucha Wuhu and nine others to travel the realm in separate routes and re-fix meng'an-mouke households: no mouke household was to exceed three hundred; from seven to ten mouke one meng'an was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifteenth year, Pucha Wuhu, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, and nine others were dispatched across the realm to re-register meng'an-mouke households: no mouke was to exceed three hundred households, and one meng'an was established for every seven to ten mouke.

sentences.zh: 十七年，又以西南、西北招討司契丹餘黨心素狠戾，複恐生事，它時或有邊隙，不為我用，令遷之于烏十裏石壘部及上京之地。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, because the remaining Khitan factions of the Southwest and Northwest Pacification Commissions were by nature fierce and unruly and might again stir trouble—if later there were border incidents they would not serve our use—they were ordered moved to the Wushili Shilei tribe and the lands of the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, because Khitan remnants under the Southwest and Northwest Pacification Commissions were fierce and unruly by nature and might stir up trouble again—useless in any future border crisis—they were ordered relocated to the Wushili Shilei tribe and the Upper Capital region.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「北邊番戍之人，歲冒寒暑往來千里，甚為勞苦。

translations.literal: The emperor said to his chief ministers: "The frontier tribesmen who garrison the north, year after year braving cold and heat and traveling a thousand li back and forth, suffer extreme hardship.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to his chief ministers: "The tribal garrison troops of the northern frontier, who year after year brave heat and cold on journeys of a thousand li, endure extreme hardship.

sentences.zh: 縱有一二馬牛，一往則無還理，且奪其農時不得耕種。

translations.literal: Even if they have one or two horses or oxen, once they go there is no prospect of return, and moreover their farming season is seized so they cannot plant.
translations.idiomatic: Even the one or two horses or oxen they possess are lost on departure with no hope of return, and their farming season is consumed so they cannot plant their fields.

sentences.zh: 故嘗命卿等議，以何術得罷其役，使安於田裏，不知卿議何如也？

translations.literal: Therefore I once ordered you to deliberate by what method their service could be ended so they might settle peacefully in their fields—I do not know what your deliberations have yielded?
translations.idiomatic: I therefore once ordered you to consider how their service might be ended so they could settle peacefully on their farms—what have your deliberations produced?

sentences.zh: 」左丞相良弼對曰：「北邊之地，不堪耕種，不能長戍，故須番戍耳。

translations.literal: " The Left Chancellor Liangbi replied: "The lands of the north cannot support farming and cannot sustain long garrisons, and therefore rotating garrisons are necessary.
translations.idiomatic: " Left Chancellor Liangbi replied: "The northern lands cannot support agriculture and cannot sustain permanent garrisons, and therefore rotating garrison duty is necessary.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「朕一日萬幾，安能遍及，卿等既為宰相，以此急務反以為末事，竟無一言，甚勞朕慮。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "I face ten thousand affairs in a day—how can I reach everywhere? You who are chancellors treat this urgent matter as a trifling affair and in the end offer not a word—it greatly burdens my concern.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "I face ten thousand affairs each day and cannot attend to everything myself. You who serve as chancellors treat this urgent matter as trivial and have offered not a single word—it weighs heavily on my mind.

sentences.zh: 往者參政宗敘屢為朕言，若以貧戶永屯邊境，使之耕種，官給糧廩，則貧者得濟，富戶免於更代之勞，使之得勤農務。

translations.literal: Formerly Participating Councilor Zongxu repeatedly spoke to me: if poor households were permanently stationed on the border to farm and plant, with the state supplying grain stores, then the poor would be aided and wealthy households freed from the labor of rotation, enabling them to devote themselves diligently to farming.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Participating Councilor Zongxu repeatedly urged me that if poor households were permanently settled on the frontier to farm, with the state supplying grain rations, the poor would be relieved and wealthy households freed from rotational duty, enabling them to devote themselves to agriculture.

sentences.zh: 若宗敘者可謂盡心為國矣！

translations.literal: One such as Zongxu may be called wholly devoted to the state!
translations.idiomatic: A man such as Zongxu may truly be said to have devoted himself wholly to the state.

sentences.zh: 朕嘗思之，宜以兩路招討司及烏古裏石壘部族、臨潢府、泰州等路分定保戍，具數以聞，朕親覽焉。

translations.literal: I have often considered that the two-route pacification commissions and the Wuguli Shilei tribes, Linhuang Prefecture, Taizhou, and other routes should be divided and fixed for garrison defense; report the full numbers—I shall review them personally.
translations.idiomatic: I have often considered that garrison assignments should be fixed for the two pacification commissions, the Wuguli Shilei tribes, Linhuang Prefecture, Taizhou, and other routes; report the full figures and I shall review them personally.

sentences.zh: 」十八年，命部族、颭分番守邊。

translations.literal: " In the eighteenth year, they ordered tribal groups and zhan units to rotate in garrisoning the border.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eighteenth year, tribal groups and zhan units were ordered to rotate in border garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以祖宗平定天下以來，所建立猛安謀克，因循既久，其間有戶口繁簡、地裏遠近不同，又自正隆之後所授無度，及大定間亦有功多未酬者，遂更定以詔天下。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, because the meng'an and mouke established since the ancestors pacified the realm had long followed old practice—with households dense or sparse and distances near or far differing among them—and because since Zhenglong appointments had been without measure and during Dading some with great merit had gone unrewarded, they were re-fixed by edict to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, because the meng'an and mouke established since the founding of the dynasty had long followed outdated arrangements—with household numbers and distances varying widely—and because appointments had been excessive since the Zhenglong era while some meritorious men of the Dading period remained unrewarded, a new regulation was promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 複命新授者並令就封，其謀克人內有六品以下職及諸局承應人，皆為遷之。

translations.literal: They again ordered that newly invested persons all take up their enfeoffments; among mouke men, those holding offices of sixth rank and below and clerks of the various bureaus were all transferred away.
translations.idiomatic: New appointees were also ordered to take up their enfeoffments in person; mouke members holding offices of sixth rank or below and clerks of the various bureaus were all transferred away.

sentences.zh: 三從以上族人願從行者，猛安不 得過十戶，謀克不得過六戶。

translations.literal: Clansmen within three degrees of mourning who wished to accompany them: a meng'an might not exceed ten households, a mouke not six households.
translations.idiomatic: Clansmen within three degrees of relationship who wished to accompany them were limited to ten households for a meng'an and six for a mouke.

sentences.zh: 詔戍邊軍士年五十五以上，許以其子及同居弟侄承替，以奴代者罪之。

translations.literal: An edict stated that border-garrison soldiers aged fifty-five and above might be replaced by their sons and co-resident younger brothers and nephews; substituting a slave was punishable.
translations.idiomatic: An edict permitted border garrison soldiers aged fifty-five and above to be replaced by their sons or co-resident younger brothers and nephews; substituting a slave was made a punishable offense.

sentences.zh: 二十一年三月，詔遣大興尹完顏迪古速遷河北東路兩猛安，上曰：「朕始令移此，欲令與女直戶相錯，安置久則自相姻親，不生異意，此長久之利也。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-first year, an edict dispatched Daxing Prefect Wanyan Digusu to relocate two meng'an of Hebei East Route; the emperor said: "When I first ordered this move, I wished them to be interspersed with Jurchen households; settled long enough they would marry among themselves and breed no alien thoughts—this is a long-term benefit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-first year, an edict dispatched Daxing Prefect Wanyan Digusu to relocate two meng'an of the Hebei East Route; the emperor said: "When I first ordered this relocation, I intended them to be interspersed with Jurchen households; given time they would intermarry and breed no disloyal thoughts—this is a lasting benefit.

sentences.zh: 今者移馬河猛安相錯以居，甚符朕意，而遙落河猛安不如此，可再遣兵部尚書張那也按視其地以雜居之。

translations.literal: Now the Yima River meng'an live interspersed, greatly matching my intent, but the Yaoluo River meng'an are not so; you may again dispatch Minister of War Zhang Naye to inspect the land and have them live mixed together.
translations.idiomatic: The Yima River meng'an now live interspersed, which accords well with my intent, but the Yaoluo River meng'an do not; dispatch Minister of War Zhang Naye again to inspect the territory and arrange mixed settlement.

sentences.zh: 」二十二年，以山東屯田戶鄰之于邊鄙，命聚之一處，俾協力蠶種。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-second year, because Shandong military-colony households neighbored the border marches, they were ordered gathered in one place so they might jointly raise silkworms and plant.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twenty-second year, because Shandong military-colony households lay adjacent to the frontier, they were ordered gathered in one place so they could jointly raise silkworms and plant crops.

sentences.zh: 右丞相烏古論元忠曰：「彼方之人以所得之地為家，雖兄弟不同處，故貧者眾。

translations.literal: " Right Chancellor Wugulun Yuanzhong said: "The people of that region take the lands they have obtained as home; even brothers do not live together, and therefore the poor are many.
translations.idiomatic: " Right Chancellor Wugulun Yuanzhong said: "The people of that region regard the lands they have received as their home; even brothers do not live together, and therefore poverty is widespread.

sentences.zh: 」參政粘割斡特剌曰：「舊時兄弟雖析猶相聚種，今則不然，宜令約束之。

translations.literal: " Participating Councilor Nian'e Wotela said: "In former times brothers, though divided, still planted together; now it is not so—they should be ordered to restrain themselves.
translations.idiomatic: " Participating Councilor Nian'e Wotela said: "In former times brothers, though living apart, still farmed together; that is no longer so, and they should be required to do so again.

sentences.zh: 」又以猛安謀克舊籍不明，遇簽軍與諸差役及賑濟，增減不以實，命括其口，以實籍之。

translations.literal: " Moreover, because the old registers of meng'an and mouke were unclear, when drafting troops and various corvée duties and relief were involved, increases and reductions were not according to fact; they were ordered to tally mouths and register them according to reality.
translations.idiomatic: " Moreover, because old meng'an-mouke registers were unclear, troop levies, corvée assignments, and relief distributions were not based on accurate figures; a household census was ordered to establish truthful registers.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，遣刑部尚書移剌綎遷山東東路八謀克處之河間，其棄地以山東東路忒黑河猛安下蘸荅謀克，移裏閔斡魯渾猛安下翕浦謀克、什母溫山謀克九村人戶徙于劉僧、安和二謀克之 舊地。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, they dispatched Minister of Justice Yila Xin to move eight mouke of Shandong East Route to Hejian; the abandoned lands were filled by the Zanda mouke under the Teihe River meng'an of Shandong East Route, and the households of the nine villages of the Xipu mouke under Yilimin Woluhun meng'an and the Shimuwenshan mouke were moved to the old lands of the Liu Seng and Anhe mouke.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Minister of Justice Yila Xin was dispatched to relocate eight mouke of the Shandong East Route to Hejian; abandoned lands were reassigned to the Zanda mouke under the Teihe River meng'an, and households of the nine villages under the Xipu mouke of Yilimin Woluhun meng'an and the Shimuwenshan mouke were moved to the former lands of the Liu Seng and Anhe mouke.

sentences.zh: 其未徙者之地皆薄惡且鄰寇，遣使詢願徙者，相可居之地，圖以進。

translations.literal: The lands of those not yet moved were all poor and bad and neighbored enemies; envoys were sent to inquire who wished to move, to find lands suitable for dwelling, and maps were submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The lands of those not yet relocated were all poor and lay adjacent to enemy territory; envoys were sent to inquire who wished to move, identify suitable dwelling places, and submit maps for approval.

sentences.zh: 上嘗以速頻、胡裏改人驍勇可用，海陵嘗欲徙之而未能，二十四年以上京率、胡剌溫之地廣而腴，遂遣刑部尚書烏裏也出府庫錢以濟行資牛畜，遷速頻一猛安、胡裏改二猛安二十四謀克以實之。

translations.literal: The emperor had often regarded the Suifen and Huligai people as fierce and brave and usable; Hailing had once wished to move them but could not; in the twenty-fourth year, because the lands of Shangjing Shuai and Huliwen were broad and fertile, they dispatched Minister of Justice Wuliye to disburse treasury funds for travel expenses, cattle, and livestock, moving one Suifen meng'an and two Huligai meng'an with twenty-four mouke to fill them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had long regarded the Suifen and Huligai peoples as fierce and capable; Hailing had once wished to relocate them but failed; in the twenty-fourth year, because the lands of Shangjing Shuai and Huliwen were broad and fertile, Minister of Justice Wuliye was dispatched to disburse treasury funds for travel expenses and livestock, relocating one Suifen meng'an and two Huligai meng'an with twenty-four mouke to populate the region.

sentences.zh: 蓋欲上京兵多，它日可為緩急之備也。

translations.literal: This was because they wished the Upper Capital to have many troops so that on another day they might serve as reserves for urgent need.
translations.idiomatic: The aim was to build up forces at the Upper Capital so they might serve as a reserve in times of crisis.

sentences.zh: 當是時，多易置河北、山東所屯之舊，括民地而為之業，戶頒牛而使之耕，畜甲兵而為之備，乃大重其權，授諸王以猛安之號，或新置者特賜之名。

translations.literal: At this time they frequently repositioned the old garrisons stationed in Hebei and Shandong, surveyed civilian lands to make them estates, distributed cattle by household for them to farm, stored armor and troops as preparation; they then greatly increased their authority, invested princes with the title of meng'an, or for newly established ones specially bestowed names.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the old garrisons in Hebei and Shandong were frequently repositioned, civilian lands were surveyed and assigned as estates, cattle were distributed by household for farming, and armor and troops were stockpiled as reserves; their authority was greatly enhanced, princes were invested with meng'an titles, and newly established units were granted special names.

sentences.zh: 制其奢靡，禁其飲酒，習其騎射，儲其糧Я，其備至嚴也。

translations.literal: They regulated their extravagance, forbade their drinking, trained them in riding and archery, stored their grain provisions—their preparations were utmost strict.
translations.idiomatic: Their extravagance was regulated, drinking forbidden, riding and archery practiced, grain stores accumulated—the preparations were exceedingly strict.

sentences.zh: 是時宗室戶百七十，猛安二百二，謀克千八百七十八，戶六十一萬五千六百二十四。

translations.literal: At this time there were one hundred seventy imperial-clan households, two hundred two meng'an, one thousand eight hundred seventy-eight mouke, and six hundred fifteen thousand six hundred twenty-four households in all.
translations.idiomatic: At this time there were one hundred seventy imperial-clan households, two hundred two meng'an, one thousand eight hundred seventy-eight mouke, and six hundred fifteen thousand six hundred twenty-four households in total.

sentences.zh: 東北路部族颭軍曰迭剌部承安三年改為土魯渾尼石合節度使，曰唐古部承安三年改為部魯火劄石合節度使，二部五颭，戶五千五百八十五。

translations.literal: On the Northeast Route, tribal zhan armies: the Diela tribe—in the third year of Cheng'an renamed Tuluhunishihe Military Commissioner; the Tanggu tribe—in the third year of Cheng'an renamed Buluhuozhashihe Military Commissioner; the two tribes with five zhan, five thousand five hundred eighty-five households.
translations.idiomatic: On the Northeast Route, tribal zhan armies included the Diela tribe, renamed the Tuluhunishihe Military Commissioner in the third year of Cheng'an, and the Tanggu tribe, renamed the Buluhuozhashihe Military Commissioner in the same year; the two tribes comprised five zhan units with five thousand five hundred eighty-five households.

sentences.zh: 其他若助魯部族、烏魯古部族、石壘部族、萌骨部族、計魯部族、孛特本部族數皆稱是。

translations.literal: Others such as the Zhulu, Wulugu, Shilei, Menggu, Jilu, and Betebu tribal groups were all of comparable numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Other tribal groups such as the Zhulu, Wulugu, Shilei, Menggu, Jilu, and Betebu were of comparable size.

sentences.zh: 西北、西南二路之颭軍十，曰蘇謨典颭、曰耶刺都颭、曰骨典颭、唐古颭、霞馬颭、木典颭、萌骨颭、咩颭、胡都颭凡九，其諸路曰曷懶、曰蒲與、曰婆速、曰恤頻、曰胡裏改、曰移懶，移懶後廢，皆在上京之鄙，或置總管府，或置節度使。

translations.literal: The zhan armies of the Northwest and Southwest two routes numbered ten: Sumodian zhan, Yeladu zhan, Gudian zhan, Tanggu zhan, Xiamo zhan, Mudian zhan, Menggu zhan, Mie zhan, and Hudu zhan—nine in all; the various routes called Yilan, Puyu, Posu, Xupin, Huligai, and Yihan—the last later abolished—all lay in the outskirts of the Upper Capital, some with chief commanders' offices established, some with military commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: The Northwest and Southwest routes fielded ten zhan units: Sumodian, Yeladu, Gudian, Tanggu, Xiamo, Mudian, Menggu, Mie, and Hudu—nine in all; the circuits of Yilan, Puyu, Posu, Xupin, Huligai, and Yihan—the last later abolished—all lay in the Upper Capital region, some administered by chief commanders' offices and others by military commissioners.

sentences.zh: 至章宗明昌間，欲國人兼知文武，令猛安謀克舉進士，試以策論及射，以定其科甲高下。

translations.literal: By the Mingchang era under Emperor Zhangzong, wishing countrymen to know both civil and military arts, they ordered meng'an and mouke to present jinshi candidates, testing them with policy essays and archery to determine the grades of their ranks.
translations.idiomatic: By the Mingchang era under Emperor Zhangzong, wishing Jurchen countrymen to master both civil and military arts, meng'an and mouke were ordered to present jinshi candidates, who were tested on policy essays and archery to determine their examination grades.

sentences.zh: 承安四年，上謂宰臣曰：「人有以《八陣圖》來上者，其圖果何如？

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Cheng'an, the emperor said to his chief ministers: "Someone has presented the Eight Formations Diagram to me—what is this diagram really like?
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Cheng'an, the emperor said to his chief ministers: "Someone has presented the Eight Formations Diagram to me—what is it really worth?

sentences.zh: 朕嘗觀宋白所集《武經》，具載攻守之法，亦多難行。

translations.literal: I have examined the Military Canon compiled by Song Bai, which fully records methods of attack and defense—yet many are hard to put into practice.
translations.idiomatic: I have read the Military Canon compiled by Song Bai, which records attack and defense methods in full—yet many are difficult to put into practice.

sentences.zh: 」右丞相清臣曰：「兵書一定之法，難以應變。

translations.literal: " Right Chancellor Qingchen said: "Fixed methods in military books are hard to apply when circumstances change.
translations.idiomatic: " Right Chancellor Qingchen said: "Fixed methods in military manuals are hard to apply when circumstances change.

sentences.zh: 本朝行兵惟用正奇二軍，臨敵制變，以正為奇，以奇為正，故無往不克。

translations.literal: Our dynasty in campaigning uses only the two forces, regular and extraordinary; facing the enemy they control change, making regular into extraordinary and extraordinary into regular, and therefore wherever they go they do not fail to conquer.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty campaigns using only regular and extraordinary forces; facing the enemy, commanders adapt on the spot, turning regular formations into extraordinary ones and vice versa, and therefore they conquer wherever they march.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「自古用兵亦不出奇正二法耳。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Since antiquity the use of troops has not gone beyond these two methods of regular and extraordinary.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "Since antiquity warfare has never gone beyond these two methods of regular and extraordinary forces.

sentences.zh: 且學古兵法如學弈棋，未能自得於心，欲用舊陣勢以接敵，疏矣。

translations.literal: Moreover, studying ancient military methods is like studying chess: without attaining mastery in one's own mind, wishing to use old formations to meet the enemy is crude indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, studying ancient military methods is like learning chess: without internal mastery, attempting to meet the enemy with old formations is hopelessly crude.

sentences.zh: 敵所應與舊勢異，則必不可支。

translations.literal: If what the enemy presents differs from the old disposition, then it certainly cannot be sustained.
translations.idiomatic: If the enemy's disposition differs from the old formation, it cannot possibly hold.

sentences.zh: 然《武經》所述雖難遵行，然知之猶愈不知。

translations.literal: Yet although what the Military Canon describes is hard to follow in practice, knowing it is still better than not knowing.
translations.idiomatic: Yet although the Military Canon's teachings are hard to follow in practice, knowing them is still better than ignorance.

sentences.zh: 」泰和間，又制武舉，其制具在《選舉志》。

translations.literal: " During the Taihe era, they also established the military examination; its regulations are fully set forth in the Treatise on Selection.
translations.idiomatic: " During the Taihe era, the military examination was also established; its regulations are set forth in full in the Treatise on Selection.

sentences.zh: 所謂渤海軍，則渤海八猛安之兵也。

translations.literal: What is called the Bohai Army is the troops of the eight Bohai meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: The so-called Bohai Army comprised the forces of the eight Bohai meng'an.

sentences.zh: 所謂奚軍者，奚人遙輦昭古牙九猛安之兵也。

translations.literal: What is called the Xi Army is the troops of the nine Xi meng'an of Yaolian Zhaoguya.
translations.idiomatic: The so-called Xi Army comprised the forces of the nine Xi meng'an under Yaolian Zhaoguya.

sentences.zh: 奚軍初徙於山西，後分遷河東。

translations.literal: The Xi Army was first moved to Shanxi, later divided and relocated to Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi Army was first relocated to Shanxi, then divided and transferred to Hedong.

sentences.zh: 其漢軍中都永固軍，大定所置者也。

translations.literal: Among Han armies, the Central Capital Yonggu Army was established in the Dading era.
translations.idiomatic: Among Han forces, the Central Capital Yonggu Army was established during the Dading era.

sentences.zh: 所謂鎮防軍，則諸軍中取以更代戍邊者也。

translations.literal: What is called the Frontier Defense Army consists of men drawn from the various armies to rotate in garrisoning the border.
translations.idiomatic: The so-called Frontier Defense Army comprised men drawn from the various armies to rotate in border garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 在西北邊則有分番屯戍軍及永屯軍驅軍之別。

translations.literal: On the northwest border there were the distinctions of rotating garrison troops, permanently stationed troops, and bond-servant troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the northwest frontier there were rotating garrison troops, permanently stationed troops, and bond-servant troops as distinct categories.

sentences.zh: 驅軍則國初所免遼人之奴婢，使屯守於泰州者也。

translations.literal: Bond-servant troops were the slaves of Liao people exempted at the founding of the state, made to garrison and guard at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bond-servant troops were Liao slaves exempted at the founding of the dynasty and assigned to garrison Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 邊鋪軍則河南、陝西居守邊界者。

translations.literal: Frontier outpost troops were those stationed to guard the borders in Henan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier outpost troops were those garrisoning the borders in Henan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 河東三虞候順德軍及章宗所置諸路效節軍，京府節鎮設三十人，防刺設二十人。

translations.literal: The three Hedong yuhou, the Shunde Army, and the various-route Loyalty Armies established by Zhangzong: in metropolitan prefectures and military commissioners' seats thirty men were posted, in defense prefectures twenty.
translations.idiomatic: The three Hedong yuhou units, the Shunde Army, and the Loyalty Armies established by Zhangzong in various circuits were staffed with thirty men in metropolitan prefectures and military commissioners' seats and twenty in defense prefectures.

sentences.zh: 掌同弓手者也。

translations.literal: They managed the same duties as archers.
translations.idiomatic: They performed the same duties as archers.

sentences.zh: 諸路所募射糧軍，五年一籍三十以下、十七以上強壯者，皆刺其缺，所以兼充雜役者也。

translations.literal: The grain-supply archers recruited in the various routes were registered every five years; sturdy men under thirty and above seventeen were all tattooed for vacancies, and thus also served miscellaneous duties.
translations.idiomatic: Grain-supply archers recruited in the various circuits were registered every five years; able-bodied men between seventeen and thirty were tattooed to fill vacancies and also performed miscellaneous corvée duties.

sentences.zh: 京師防城軍，世宗大定十七年三月改為武衛軍，則掌京師巡捕者也。

translations.literal: The capital city-defense army—in the third month of the seventeenth year of Dading under Emperor Shizong renamed the Martial Guard Army—managed patrol and arrest in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The capital city-defense force, renamed the Martial Guard Army in the third month of the seventeenth year of Dading under Emperor Shizong, was responsible for patrol and arrest in the capital.

sentences.zh: 其曰牢城軍，則嘗為盜竊者，以充防築之役。

translations.literal: What was called the Prison-City Army were those who had once been thieves, used to fill duties of defense and construction.
translations.idiomatic: The so-called Prison-City Army comprised former thieves assigned to defense and construction labor.

sentences.zh: 曰土兵，則以司警捕之事。

translations.literal: What were called local troops managed matters of alarm and arrest.
translations.idiomatic: Local troops were responsible for alarm and arrest duties.

sentences.zh: 凡漢軍，有事則簽取於民，事已則或亦放免。

translations.literal: As for Han armies generally, when there was business they were drafted from the people; when affairs ended they were sometimes also released and exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Han armies were generally drafted from the populace when needed and sometimes discharged when campaigns ended.

sentences.zh: 初，天會間，郭藥師降，有曰長勝軍者，皆遼水側人也，以鄉土歸金，皆愁怨思歸，宗望及令罷還。

translations.literal: At first, during Tianhui, when Guo Yaoshi surrendered, there was what was called the Ever-Victorious Army, all people of the Liao River banks; having returned to the Jin for their native lands, they were all sorrowful and resentful, wishing to return home, and Zongwang promptly ordered them disbanded and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianhui era, when Guo Yaoshi surrendered, there was an army called the Ever-Victorious Army, composed of people from the banks of the Liao River; having joined the Jin out of attachment to their homeland, they were resentful and homesick, and Zongwang promptly ordered them disbanded and sent home.

sentences.zh: 正隆間，又嘗罷諸路漢軍，而所存者猶有威勇、威烈、威捷、順德及「韓常之軍」之號。

translations.literal: During Zhenglong, they again once disbanded Han armies of the various routes, yet those that remained still bore the names Awesome Courage, Awesome Fierceness, Awesome Swiftness, Shunde, and "Han Chang's Army."
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenglong era, Han armies in the various circuits were again disbanded, yet those that remained still bore names such as Awesome Courage, Awesome Fierceness, Awesome Swiftness, Shunde, and Han Chang's Army.

sentences.zh: 凡邊境置兵之州三十八：鳳翔、延安、鄧、鞏、熙、泗、潁、蔡、隴、秦、河、海、壽、唐、商、洮、蘭、會、積石、鎮戎、保安、綏德、保德、環、葭、庾、甯邊、東勝、淨、慶、來遠、桓、昌、曷懶、婆速、蒲與、恤品、胡裏改。

translations.literal: In all, thirty-eight prefectures where troops were stationed on the border: Fengxiang, Yan'an, Deng, Gong, Xi, Si, Ying, Cai, Long, Qin, He, Hai, Shou, Tang, Shang, Tao, Lan, Hui, Jishi, Zhenrong, Bao'an, Suide, Baode, Huan, Jia, Yu, Ningbian, Dongsheng, Jing, Qing, Laiyuan, Huan, Chang, Yilan, Posu, Puyu, Xupin, and Huligai.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-eight prefectures stationed troops along the frontier: Fengxiang, Yan'an, Deng, Gong, Xi, Si, Ying, Cai, Long, Qin, He, Hai, Shou, Tang, Shang, Tao, Lan, Hui, Jishi, Zhenrong, Bao'an, Suide, Baode, Huan, Jia, Yu, Ningbian, Dongsheng, Jing, Qing, Laiyuan, Huan, Chang, Yilan, Posu, Puyu, Xupin, and Huligai.

sentences.zh: 置於要州者十一：南京、東京、益都、京兆、太原、臨洮、臨潢、豐、泰、撫、蓋。

translations.literal: Stationed at key prefectures were eleven: Southern Capital, Eastern Capital, Yidu, Jingzhao, Taiyuan, Lintao, Linhuang, Feng, Tai, Fu, and Gai.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven key prefectures were garrisoned: the Southern Capital, Eastern Capital, Yidu, Jingzhao, Taiyuan, Lintao, Linhuang, Feng, Tai, Fu, and Gai.

sentences.zh: 及宣宗南遷，颭軍潰去，兵勢益弱，遂盡擁猛安戶之老稚渡河，僑置諸總管府以統之，器械既缺，糧Я不給，朘民膏血而不足，乃行括糧之法，一人從征，舉家待哺。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong moved south, the zhan armies collapsed and fled, military strength grew ever weaker, and they then drove all the old and young of meng'an households across the river, placing them provisionally under various chief commanders' offices to govern them; weapons were already lacking, grain provisions not supplied, draining the people's lifeblood yet still insufficient—thereupon they implemented the method of surveying grain: one man went on campaign, the whole family waited to be fed.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong moved the court south, the zhan armies collapsed and fled, military strength weakened further, and the old and young of meng'an households were driven across the river and provisionally placed under various chief commanders' offices; weapons were scarce, grain supplies inadequate, and draining the people's resources still proved insufficient—thereupon grain surveys were instituted: one man went to war while his entire family waited to be fed.

sentences.zh: 又謂無以堅戰士之心，乃令其家盡入京師，不數年至無以為食，乃聽其出，而國亦屈矣。

translations.literal: Also thinking there was no way to firm warriors' hearts, they then ordered their families all to enter the capital; within a few years until there was nothing to eat, then allowed them to leave, and the state also was bent low.
translations.idiomatic: Believing this would steady the soldiers' resolve, they ordered soldiers' families into the capital; within a few years they could no longer feed themselves, and when they were finally allowed to leave, the state itself had already been brought low.

sentences.zh: 然初南渡時，盡以河朔戰兵三十萬分隸河南行樞密及帥府，往往蔽匿強壯，驅羸弱使戰，不能取勝。

translations.literal: Yet when first crossing south, all thirty myriad combat troops of Heshuo were divided and assigned to the Henan Mobile Privy Council and marshal prefectures; they often concealed the strong and drove the weak to fight, and could not win.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at the first southern crossing, three hundred thousand Heshuo combat troops were divided among the Henan Mobile Privy Council and the various marshal prefectures; commanders routinely hid the able-bodied and sent the weak into battle, and victories proved impossible.

sentences.zh: 後乃至以二十五人為謀克，四謀克為猛安。

translations.literal: Later it even reached the point of making twenty-five men a mouke and four mouke a meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: Later the organization shrank so far that twenty-five men constituted a mouke and four mouke a meng'an.

sentences.zh: 每謀克除旗鼓司火頭五人，任戰者止十八人，不足成隊伍，但務存其名而已。

translations.literal: Each mouke, excluding five for the banners-and-drums office and fire-heads, had only eighteen men who actually fought—not enough to form a unit, but only sought to preserve the name.
translations.idiomatic: After deducting five men for the banners-and-drums staff and fire-heads, each mouke had only eighteen men available for combat—too few to make a proper unit, yet the titles were kept up all the same.

sentences.zh: 故混源劉祁謂：「金之兵制最弊，每有征伐及邊釁，輒下令簽軍，使遠近騷動。

translations.literal: Therefore Liu Qi of Hunyuan said: "The Jin military system is most flawed; whenever there were campaigns and border incidents, they immediately ordered troop drafts, making near and far disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi of Hunyuan therefore remarked: "The Jin military system is at its worst whenever campaigns or border clashes arise and the court orders a general draft, throwing the countryside into turmoil from end to end.

sentences.zh: 民家丁男若皆強壯，或盡取無遺，號泣動乎鄰里，嗟怨盈于道路，驅此使戰，欲其勝敵，難矣！

translations.literal: If all adult males in civilian households were sturdy, they were sometimes taken entirely without remainder; wailing moved the neighborhood, sighs and resentment filled the roads—driving these to fight and expecting them to defeat the enemy is hard indeed!"
translations.idiomatic: When every able-bodied man in a household was strong, the authorities sometimes took them all, leaving none behind; neighbors heard their cries, the roads filled with lament and anger—and to drive such men into battle and expect victory is simply impossible."

sentences.zh: 」初，貞祐時，下令簽軍，會一時任子為監當者春赴吏部選，宰執命取為監官軍，皆憤慍哀號交醖台省，至沖宰相鹵簿以告，丞相僕散七斤大怒，趣左右取弓矢射去。

translations.literal: At first, during the Zhenyou era, when troops were drafted, it happened that sons holding supply-office posts were going in spring to the Ministry of Personnel selection; the chief ministers ordered them taken as supervisory army officers. All were indignant and wailing, filling the Censorate and Secretariat; one man rushed the chancellor's procession to report, and Chancellor Pusan Qijin was furious and ordered attendants to fetch bow and arrows to shoot at them.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhenyou era, when a draft was ordered, sons serving as supply-office clerks happened to be in the capital for the spring Ministry of Personnel examinations; the chief ministers ordered them impressed as army supervisors. Outraged wails filled the Censorate and Secretariat until one man broke through the chancellor's escort to protest. Chancellor Pusan Qijin flew into a rage and ordered his attendants to take up bow and arrows and drive the crowd away.

sentences.zh: 已而，上知其不可用，命免之。

translations.literal: Before long, the emperor knew it could not be used and ordered them exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the emperor recognized that the measure was unworkable and ordered the clerks released from service.

sentences.zh: 元光末，備潼關黃河，又簽軍，諸使者曆縣邑，自見居官外，無文武小大職事官皆充軍。

translations.literal: At the end of the Yuanguang era, in preparing Tongguan and the Yellow River, troops were drafted again; envoys traveled through counties and districts, and apart from officials currently on duty, all civil and military officers great and small with official posts were made to serve as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Yuanguang era, while preparing the defenses of Tongguan and the Yellow River, another draft was ordered; imperial envoys toured every county and district, and every civil and military official with a post—save those actually holding office at the time—was pressed into military service.

sentences.zh: 至許州，前侍御史劉元規年幾六十，亦選為千戶。

translations.literal: At Xuzhou, the former attendant censor Liu Yuangui, nearly sixty years old, was also selected as a qianhu.
translations.idiomatic: At Xuzhou, the former attendant censor Liu Yuangui, who was nearly sixty, was also chosen to serve as a qianhu.

sentences.zh: 至陳州，以祁父從益以前監察禦史亦為千戶，余不可悉紀。

translations.literal: At Chenzhou, Liu Qi's father Congyi, formerly a surveillance censor, was also made a qianhu; the rest cannot all be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: At Chenzhou, Liu Qi's father Congyi, formerly a surveillance censor, was likewise appointed qianhu; too many similar cases exist to record them all.

sentences.zh: 既立部伍，必以軍律相臨，物議紛然，後亦罷之。

translations.literal: Once units were established, military law necessarily pressed upon them; public opinion was clamorous, and later this too was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Once the units were formed, strict military law was imposed on them; public outcry was fierce, and the arrangement was eventually abandoned.

sentences.zh: 哀宗正大二年，議選諸路精兵，直隸密院。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengda under Emperor Aizong, it was proposed to select elite troops from the various routes and place them directly under the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengda under Emperor Aizong, the court proposed selecting elite troops from every circuit and placing them directly under the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 先設總領六員，分路揀閱，因相合併。

translations.literal: Six chief controllers were first established to inspect and review troops route by route, then merge them together.
translations.idiomatic: Six chief controllers were first appointed to inspect troops circuit by circuit and then consolidate them.

sentences.zh: 每總領司率數萬人，軍勢既張，乃易總領之名為都尉，班在隨朝四品之列，曰建威、曰虎威、曰破虜、振威、鷹揚、虎賁、振武、折沖、蕩寇、殄寇。

translations.literal: Each chief controller's office led tens of thousands of men; once military strength was deployed, the name chief controller was changed to commandant, with rank in the fourth grade attending court: Jianwei, Huwei, Polu, Zhenwei, Yingyang, Huben, Zhenwu, Zhechong, Dangkou, and Tiankou.
translations.idiomatic: Each chief controller commanded tens of thousands of men; when their forces were fully mustered, the title was changed to commandant, with rank equivalent to fourth-grade court officials. The designations included Jianwei, Huwei, Polu, Zhenwei, Yingyang, Huben, Zhenwu, Zhechong, Dangkou, and Tiankou.

sentences.zh: 必以先嘗秉帥權者居是職，雖帥府行院亦不敢以貴重臨之。

translations.literal: Those who had previously held command authority were invariably placed in these posts; even marshal prefectures and mobile bureaus dared not press them with their lofty status.
translations.idiomatic: The posts were invariably filled by men who had previously held field command, and even marshal prefectures and mobile bureaus did not dare assert precedence over them by rank.

sentences.zh: 天興初元，有十五都尉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Tianxing era, there were fifteen commandants.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Tianxing era, there were fifteen commandants.

sentences.zh: 先六人升授，在京建威奧屯斡裏卜，許州折沖夾穀澤本姓樊，陳州振武溫撒辛本姓李，蔡州蕩寇蒲察打吉卜，申裕安平完顏斜列，嵩汝振武唐括韓僧。

translations.literal: The first six were promoted and appointed: at the capital, Jianwei Aotun Wolibo; at Xuzhou, Zhechong Jiagu Ze, original surname Fan; at Chenzhou, Zhenwu Wensaxin, original surname Li; at Caizhou, Dangkou Pucha Dajibu; at Shenyu and Anping, Wanyan Xielie; at Song and Ru, Zhenwu Tangguo Hanseng.
translations.idiomatic: Six were promoted first: Jianwei Aotun Wolibo at the capital; Zhechong Jiagu Ze, original surname Fan, at Xuzhou; Zhenwu Wensaxin, original surname Li, at Chenzhou; Dangkou Pucha Dajibu at Caizhou; Wanyan Xielie at Shenyu and Anping; and Zhenwu Tangguo Hanseng in the Song and Ru region.

sentences.zh: 續封金昌府虎威紇石烈乞兒，宣權歸德果毅完顏豬兒，南京殄寇完顏阿拍。

translations.literal: Subsequently enfeoffed were: Jinchang Prefecture Huwei Hesheilie Qier; acting authority at Guide, Guoyi Wanyan Zhuer; and Southern Capital Tiankou Wanyan Apai.
translations.idiomatic: Later appointments included Huwei Hesheilie Qier at Jinchang Prefecture; Guoyi Wanyan Zhuer with acting authority at Guide; and Tiankou Wanyan Apai at the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 宣權潼關都尉三：虎賁完顏陳兒、鷹揚內族大婁室、全節。

translations.literal: Three acting commandants of Tongguan: Huben Wanyan Chener, Yingyang of the inner clan Daloushi, and Quanjie.
translations.idiomatic: Three acting commandants were assigned to Tongguan: Huben Wanyan Chener, Yingyang Daloushi of the inner clan, and Quanjie.

sentences.zh: 複取河朔諸路歸正人，不問鞍馬有無、譯語能否，悉送密院，增月給三倍它軍，授以官馬，得千餘人，歲時犒燕，名曰忠孝軍。

translations.literal: They again took guizheng men from the various Heshuo routes, regardless of whether they had saddles and horses or could interpret languages, and sent them all to the Privy Council; monthly pay was triple that of other armies, official horses were granted, and over a thousand men were obtained; seasonal rewards and feasts were given, and they were named the Loyal and Filial Army.
translations.idiomatic: The court again gathered guizheng men—northerners who had rejoined the Jin—from every Heshuo circuit, without regard to horses, saddles, or interpreter skills, and sent them all to the Privy Council. Their monthly pay was triple that of other units, they were issued government horses, and more than a thousand men were enrolled. Seasonal rewards and feasts were provided, and the force was named the Loyal and Filial Army.

sentences.zh: 以石抹燕山奴、蒲察定住統之。

translations.literal: Shi Mo Yanshan'nu and Pucha Dingzhu commanded them.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Mo Yanshan'nu and Pucha Dingzhu were placed in overall command.

sentences.zh: 加以正大已後諸路所虜、臨陳所獲，皆放歸鄉土，同忠孝軍給其犒賞，使河朔俘系知之。

translations.literal: Moreover, after Zhengda, captives taken on the various routes and prisoners seized in battle were all released to their native lands and given the same rewards as the Loyal and Filial Army, so that Heshuo prisoners in captivity would know of this.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhengda, moreover, captives taken on campaign and prisoners seized in battle were released to their home districts and granted the same rewards as the Loyal and Filial Army, so that captives still held in Heshuo would hear of the policy.

sentences.zh: 故此軍迄於天興至七千，千戶以上將帥尚不預焉。

translations.literal: Therefore this army by Tianxing reached seven thousand, not counting generals and commanders of qianhu rank and above.
translations.idiomatic: By the Tianxing era this army had grown to seven thousand men, not counting the officers of qianhu rank and above.

sentences.zh: 又以歸正人過多，乃系于忠孝籍中別為一軍，減忠孝所給之半，不能射者令閱習一再月，然後試補忠孝軍，是所謂合裏合軍也。

translations.literal: Because guizheng men were too numerous, they were registered separately within the Loyal and Filial rolls as another army, with half the pay of the Loyal and Filial Army; those unable to shoot were made to drill for one or two months, then tested and transferred to supplement the Loyal and Filial Army—this was what was called the Heli Army.
translations.idiomatic: Because guizheng recruits were too numerous, a separate register was created within the Loyal and Filial rolls and formed into another army at half pay. Men who could not shoot were drilled for one or two months and then tested for transfer into the Loyal and Filial Army; this was the so-called Heli Army.

sentences.zh: 又以親衛馬軍，舊時所選未精，必加閱試，直取武藝如忠孝軍者得五千人，餘罷歸為步軍。

translations.literal: Also the imperial guard cavalry, whose earlier selections had not been refined, were given additional review and testing; only those with martial skill matching the Loyal and Filial Army, five thousand men, were kept, and the rest were dismissed to become infantry.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial guard cavalry, whose earlier selection had been lax, were put through further review; only five thousand men whose martial skill matched that of the Loyal and Filial Army were retained, and the rest were demoted to infantry.

sentences.zh: 凡進征，忠孝居前，馬軍次之。

translations.literal: On all advances, the Loyal and Filial went first and the cavalry second.
translations.idiomatic: On campaign the Loyal and Filial Army marched in the van and the cavalry followed.

sentences.zh: 自正大改立馬軍，隊伍鞍勒兵甲一切更新，將相舊人自謂國家全盛之際馬數則有之，至於軍士精銳、器仗堅整，較之今日有不侔者，中興之期為有望矣。

translations.literal: Since Zhengda, when the cavalry was reorganized, units, saddles, harness, arms, and armor were all renewed; old generals and ministers said that at the state's full prosperity there were horse numbers, but as for soldiers refined and sharp and weapons and gear solid and complete, compared with today there were unmatched ones—the prospect of restoration was hopeful.
translations.idiomatic: From the Zhengda reorganization of the cavalry onward, units, saddles, harness, arms, and armor were all renewed. Veteran commanders remarked that in the dynasty's heyday horse numbers had been ample, but in soldierly quality and the soundness of weapons and equipment the present force was unmatched—and the hope of revival seemed within reach.

sentences.zh: 一日布列曹門內教埸，忠孝軍七千，馬軍五千，京師所屯建威都尉軍萬人，內族九住所統親衛軍三千，及阿排所統四千，皆哀宗控制樞密院時所選，教場地約三十頃尚不能容，余都尉十三四軍猶不在是數。

translations.literal: One day they were arrayed at the training ground inside Caomen: the Loyal and Filial Army seven thousand, cavalry five thousand, ten thousand of the Jianwei commandant army garrisoned in the capital, three thousand imperial guards under the inner-clan Jiujiu, and four thousand under Apai—all selected when Aizong controlled the Privy Council. The training ground covered about thirty qing and still could not contain them; thirteen or fourteen other commandant armies were not in this count.
translations.idiomatic: One day the troops were drawn up at the drill ground inside Caomen: seven thousand Loyal and Filial soldiers, five thousand cavalry, ten thousand men of the Jianwei commandant force garrisoned in the capital, three thousand imperial guards under the inner-clan officer Jiujiu, and four thousand under Apai—all chosen while Emperor Aizong held direct control of the Privy Council. The drill field covered some thirty qing and still could not hold them, and another thirteen or fourteen commandant armies were not included in the muster.

sentences.zh: 此外，招集義軍名曰忠義，要皆燕、趙亡命，雖獲近用，終不可制，異時擅殺北使唐慶以速金亡者即此曹也。

translations.literal: Besides this, volunteer armies called Loyal Righteous were recruited, mostly Yan and Zhao fugitives; though put to immediate use, they ultimately could not be controlled—the ones who later on their own killed the northern envoy Tang Qing and hastened the Jin's fall were this crowd.
translations.idiomatic: In addition, volunteer forces called the Loyal Righteous Army were recruited, composed largely of outlaws from Yan and Zhao. Though pressed into service, they could never be controlled—the men who later murdered the northern envoy Tang Qing on their own authority and hastened the dynasty's collapse belonged to this very group.

sentences.zh: 禁軍之制

translations.literal: The system of imperial guards.
translations.idiomatic: Administration of Imperial Guards.

sentences.zh: 本於合紮謀克。

translations.literal: It was based on hezha mouke.
translations.idiomatic: It originated in the hezha mouke.

sentences.zh: 合紮者，言親軍也，以近親所領，故以名焉。

translations.literal: Hezha means personal guard troops, led by close kin—hence the name.
translations.idiomatic: Hezha denoted the personal guard, so called because it was commanded by close kinsmen of the throne.

sentences.zh: 貞元遷都，更以太祖、遼王宗幹、秦王宗翰之軍為合紮猛安，謂之侍衛親軍，故立侍衛親軍司以統之。

translations.literal: When the capital was moved in the Zhenyuan era, the armies of Taizu, Prince of Liao Zonggan, and Prince of Qin Zonghan were reorganized as hezha meng'an, called the Palace Guard Personal Army; therefore the Palace Guard Personal Army Bureau was established to command them.
translations.idiomatic: At the Zhenyuan relocation, the forces of Taizu, Prince of Liao Zonggan, and Prince of Qin Zonghan were reorganized as hezha meng'an and styled the Palace Guard Personal Army; a Palace Guard Personal Army Bureau was therefore established to command them.

sentences.zh: 舊常選諸軍之材武者為護駕軍，海陵又名上京龍翔軍為神勇軍，正隆二年將南伐，乃罷歸，使就僉調，複于侍衛親軍四猛安舊止曰太祖、遼王、秦王猛安凡三，今曰四猛安，未詳，豈太祖兩猛安耶？

translations.literal: Formerly the able and martial from the various armies were selected as the imperial escort army; Hailing also renamed the Upper Capital Dragon Soaring Army the Divine Valor Army. In the second year of Zhenglong, when a southern campaign was planned, they were disbanded and sent home for collective levy. Among the four meng'an of the Palace Guard Personal Army, the old record lists only three—the Taizu, Prince of Liao, and Prince of Qin meng'an; now it says four meng'an; the detail is unclear—could Taizu have had two meng'an?
translations.idiomatic: In earlier times the ablest fighters from the various armies were chosen for the imperial escort. Hailing also renamed the Upper Capital Dragon Soaring Army the Divine Valor Army. In the second year of Zhenglong, as a southern campaign was planned, these units were disbanded and sent home for collective levy. The Palace Guard Personal Army was said to comprise four meng'an, though older records name only three—for Taizu, the Prince of Liao, and the Prince of Qin; whether Taizu originally had two meng'an is unclear.

sentences.zh: 內，選三十以下千六百人，騎兵曰龍翔，步兵曰虎步，以備宿衛。

translations.literal: Within this, sixteen hundred men under thirty were selected; cavalry were called Dragon Soaring and infantry Tiger Pace, to serve as palace guards.
translations.idiomatic: From these, sixteen hundred men under thirty were chosen: cavalry styled Dragon Soaring and infantry styled Tiger Pace, to serve as palace guards.

sentences.zh: 五年，罷親軍司，以所掌付大興府，置左右驍騎，所謂從駕軍也，置都副指揮使隸點檢司，步軍都副指揮使隸宣徽院。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Personal Army Bureau was abolished and its duties given to Daxing Prefecture; Left and Right Valiant Cavalry were established—the so-called imperial escort troops—with chief and deputy commanders subordinate to the Bureau of Palace Inspection, and chief and deputy infantry commanders subordinate to the Palace Service Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Personal Army Bureau was abolished and its functions transferred to Daxing Prefecture. Left and Right Valiant Cavalry—the so-called imperial escort troops—were established, with chief and deputy cavalry commanders under the Bureau of Palace Inspection and chief and deputy infantry commanders under the Palace Service Bureau.

sentences.zh: 大定初，親軍置四千人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dading, the personal guard numbered four thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Dading era, the personal guard numbered four thousand men.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，省為三千五百。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, it was reduced to three thousand five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the force was reduced to three thousand five hundred.

sentences.zh: 上京亦設守衛軍。

translations.literal: The Upper Capital also established a garrison guard.
translations.idiomatic: A garrison guard was also established at the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，尚書省奏：「上京既設皇城提舉官，亦當設軍守衛。

translations.literal: That year the Ministry of Revenue memorialized: "Since the Upper Capital has already established an intendant for the imperial city, a garrison guard should also be established.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Ministry of Revenue memorialized: "Now that the Upper Capital has an intendant for the imperial city, a garrison guard should be established as well.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「可設四百五十，馬一百二十，分三番更代。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Four hundred fifty may be established, with one hundred twenty horses, divided into three shifts for rotation.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor replied: "Establish four hundred fifty men, with one hundred twenty horses, divided into three rotating shifts.

sentences.zh: 異時朕至上京，即作兩番巡警，限以半年交替。

translations.literal: When in future I go to the Upper Capital, they shall patrol in two shifts, alternating every half year.
translations.idiomatic: When I visit the Upper Capital hereafter, they shall patrol in two shifts, rotating every six months.

sentences.zh: 人日給錢五十、米一升半，馬給芻粟，猛安謀克官可差年四十上下者、軍士並取三十以上者充。

translations.literal: Each man shall receive fifty cash and one and a half sheng of rice daily; horses shall receive fodder and grain. Meng'an and mouke officers may be chosen from men around forty years of age, and soldiers shall all be taken from those thirty and above.
translations.idiomatic: Each man shall receive fifty cash and one and a half sheng of rice per day; horses shall receive fodder and grain. Meng'an and mouke officers may be drawn from men of about forty, and soldiers from men thirty and older.

sentences.zh: 」章宗承安四年，增為五千，又增至六千。

translations.literal: " In the fourth year of Chengan under Zhangzong, the force was increased to five thousand, and then again to six thousand.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fourth year of Chengan under Emperor Zhangzong, the garrison was increased to five thousand and then to six thousand.

sentences.zh: 又有威捷軍。

translations.literal: There was also the Awesome Swiftness Army.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Awesome Swiftness Army.

sentences.zh: 承安增簽弩手千人。

translations.literal: In Chengan, one thousand crossbowmen were added by draft.
translations.idiomatic: During Chengan one thousand crossbowmen were added by draft.

sentences.zh: 凡選弩手之制，先以營造尺度杖，其長六尺，立之謂之等杖。

translations.literal: As for the system for selecting crossbowmen, first a measuring staff of construction standard was used; it was six feet long, and when set upright it was called the equal staff.
translations.idiomatic: Crossbowmen were selected by a fixed standard: a measuring rod six feet long, set upright, was called the equal staff.

sentences.zh: 取身與杖等，能踏弩至三石，鋪弦解索登踏閑習，射六箭皆上垛，內二箭中貼者。

translations.literal: Those whose height matched the staff, who could draw a crossbow to three shi, who could string, unstring, step, and tread with practiced ease, and who shot six arrows all hitting the rampart—with two hitting the center paste—were chosen.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates had to match the staff in height, draw a crossbow to three shi, string and unstring it and work the treading mechanism with practiced ease, and place all six shots on the target rampart, with two in the center bullseye.

sentences.zh: 又選親軍，取身長五尺五寸善騎射者，猛安謀克以名上兵部，移點檢司、宣徽院試補之。

translations.literal: Personal guards were also selected: men five feet five inches tall who were skilled at riding and shooting; meng'an and mouke submitted their names to the Ministry of War, and the Bureau of Palace Inspection and Palace Service Bureau tested and enrolled them.
translations.idiomatic: Personal guards were also chosen from men five feet five inches in height who excelled at riding and shooting; meng'an and mouke submitted names to the Ministry of War, and the Bureau of Palace Inspection and Palace Service Bureau tested and enrolled the candidates.

sentences.zh: 又設護衛二百人，近侍之執兵仗者也，取五品至七品官子孫及宗室並親軍、諸局分承應人，身長五尺六寸者，選試補之。

translations.literal: Two hundred bodyguards were also established—the close attendants who bore arms—chosen from descendants of fifth- to seventh-rank officials, imperial clansmen, personal guards, and attendants of the various bureaus; those five feet six inches tall were selected by test and enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred bodyguards were also established—the close attendants who carried weapons—drawn from descendants of officials of the fifth through seventh ranks, imperial clansmen, personal guards, and attendants of the various bureaus; men five feet six inches tall were chosen by examination.

sentences.zh: 又設控鶴二百人，皆以備出入者也。

translations.literal: Two hundred Crane Controllers were also established, all to attend the emperor's coming and going.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred Crane Controllers were also established, all to attend the emperor whenever he went abroad.

sentences.zh: 大將府治之稱號。

translations.literal: Titles of the Great General Prefecture administration.
translations.idiomatic: Titles of the Great General Prefecture Administration.

sentences.zh: 收國元年十二月，始置咸州軍帥司，以經略遼地，討高永昌，置南路都統司，且以討張覺。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Shouguo, the Xianzhou Army Marshal Bureau was first established to manage Liao territory and campaign against Gao Yongchang; the Southern Route Chief Command Bureau was established, and also to campaign against Zhang Jue.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Shouguo, the Xianzhou Army Marshal Bureau was first established to secure Liao territory and campaign against Gao Yongchang, and the Southern Route Chief Command Bureau was also set up to campaign against Zhang Jue.

sentences.zh: 天輔五年襲遼主，始有內外諸軍都統之名。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianfu, when the Liao ruler was attacked, the title of chief commander of inner and outer armies first appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianfu, during the attack on the Liao ruler, the title of chief commander of the inner and outer armies first appeared.

sentences.zh: 時以奚未平，又置奚路都統司，後改為六部路都統司，以遙輦九營為九猛安隸焉，與上京及泰州凡六處置，每司統五六萬人，又以渤海軍為八猛安。

translations.literal: At the time, because the Xi were not yet pacified, the Xi Route Chief Command Bureau was also established; later it was changed to the Six Departments Route Chief Command Bureau.
